## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature and SuttaCentral)
*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and SuttaCentral data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*
The *Abbhantaramātikā* constitutes the second section (Dt 1.2) of the *Dhātukathā*, the third book of the Abhidhamma Piṭaka [SuttaCentral]. It serves as an internal matrix or schedule of doctrinal items, distinguished from the external table (*bāhira-mātikā*) [U Nārada 1962]. In his analysis of early Abhidharma structures, Erich Frauwallner notes that this section of the *Dhātukathā* draws upon a substantial portion of the doctrinal lists found in the *Vibhaṅga*, which it expands through additions [Frauwallner 1995]. SuttaCentral records one translation in one language [SuttaCentral], including the English translation by U Nārada, where the section is titled "Internal Tables (Abbhantara mātikā)" [U Nārada 1962].
According to DharmaNexus, the text exhibits significant Pali-internal text reuse, sharing 75 matching passages with 12 texts [DharmaNexus]. Its closest correspondences occur with the *Abhidhammamātikāpāḷi* (over 1,100 characters shared), Vinaya passages in the *Bhikkhu Vibhaṅga* (Pārājika 4 and Pācittiya 8), the *Anupada Sutta* of the Majjhima Nikāya (MN 111), the *Visuddhimagga*, both *Niddesa* treatises (*Sāriputtasuttaniddesa* and *Khaggavisāṇasuttaniddesa*), and commentary literature such as the *Paṭisambhidāmagga-aṭṭhakathā* [DharmaNexus]. In cross-language automated alignments, DharmaNexus detects high-scoring matches with Sanskrit texts featuring standard Abhidharmic and doctrinal enumerations, particularly the *Arthaviniścayasūtra*, along with alignments in the *Daśasāhasrikā Prajñāpāramitā* and the *Mahāsāhasrapramardanī* [DharmaNexus].
